name: reaping scythe
desc:
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} sweeps its spectral scythe through a creature within 5 feet of it, dealing 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} sweeps its spectral scythe through a creature within 5 feet of it.
